title: TMZ posts a video from Mike Vrabel, Dianna Russini 2021 boat outing

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: TMZ posts a video from Mike Vrabel, Dianna Russini 2021 boat outing
sources.description: Exactly one month to the day since the first photos of Patriots coach and NFL reporter Dianna Russini emerged, TMZ has supplemented its report regarding the renting of a boat by the pair in June 2021 with a video of them on the dock.
